component.subject: Call to Worship
component.source: Hosea 6:1a, 3b (World English Bible), abridged; "Yahweh" rendered "the Lord". The selection follows Noyes, Prayers for Services (1934).

original.p: Hosea 6:1 (WEB): “Come, and let us return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.

Hosea 6:3 (WEB): Let us acknowledge Yahweh. Let us press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”

block.p: Come, and let us return to the Lord, for he will heal us.

p.line: As surely as the sun rises,
He will come to us like the rain,
like the spring rain that waters the earth.
